Finally, she's on a mission at another museum to learn all about a baby Parasaurolophus, when a real one pops up behind her!

programme.title: Meekah

She learns about the international space station, does a space walk and goes on a simulated trip to Mars!

His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

Then, Newt has an accident with some paint flecks and is misdiagnosed with an infectious tropical illness, forcing her into quarantine. Finally, Pogo and Jeff get into a battle over who can sell the best ice creams, which escalates to destructive levels.

Then, Zee and Jeff are forced to live together when Jeff calls fumigators on Zee's house. How long can this alliance of opposites last? Plus, when Newt goes on holiday, Zee is enlisted to house-sit and look after her beloved pet hamster!

So Blippi learns all about light and electricity. He goes through tunnels, plays both giant and regular pianos and even makes a shadow puppet show with his hands!

He soon discovers the only thing that can get her to agree: the final sticker for her collection. Then, Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' mind control chips and picks poor Fuse as the object of his latest experiment! Finally, Pogo convinces the others a monster is on the loose, but it's just another one of his pranks.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are learning some hard lessons! Pogo is struck with a new obsession: capturing viral videos to upload to the internet for fame. But he's about to learn that it's not as easy as it seems! Then, after one tantrum too many, Fuse accepts Newt's help to overcome his anger issues. Finally, Jeff gets his fortune read by a mysterious teller, but when he refuses to pay, she places a curse on him!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some tricky situations! First, Slick receives a knitted hat from Newt that he hates, so he comes up with a plan to 'accidentally' lose it so he doesn't hurt her feelings. Then, Fuse's terrible temper while watching sports gets him in trouble, and he has to try his best to keep a lid on it while watching a game with Newt. The trouble continues when Jeff gets a mysterious itch and blames it on a sleeping Zee!

Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: Morphle

First, Doubler accidentally multiplies monster truck Orphle, and all the new Orphles team up to cause trouble in Pet Port! The bad ideas continue as the two villains try to cheat to win a game of Capture the Flag!

The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Hansel And Gretel
programme.desc: When Eun-soo gets lost in a country road, he meets a mysterious girl and is led to her fairy tale-like house in the middle of the forest. There, Eun-soo is trapped with the girl and her siblings who never age. Soon he learns that all the adults who visited or stayed in the house have met mysterious yet terrible ends. More shockingly, their cruel deaths are drawn in detail and made into a fairy tale book by the children. Scared, Eun-soo tries to find the way out, but the house is secluded in the forest with no way out. And then, Eun-soo finally discovers a book which tells the brutal end of none other than himself!

programme.title: Bodyguard
programme.desc: After losing his loved ones, Soohan also loses the will to leave. Aimless and unmotivated, he and his good friends Taeyoung and Jincheol work for a loan shark, although Soohan cannot even muster any enthusiasm for a life in crime. One day, he chances into a heiress Yejin being accosted by suited thugs. Like a fairtytale, he suddenly has a new lease on life. After rescuing her, Soohan promises to protect her, happy to take only her watch as collateral. Meanwhile, Soohan's boss starts looking for Yejin and soon learns of their relationship.

programme.title: Pintu Neraka
programme.desc: Kamasani, a business tycoon with terminal cancer seeks Mahabub, a mysterious recluse rumoured to possess a cure. After treatment, Kamasani feels his cancer reducing but starts having serious side effects where he starts to hallucinate and become violent. When a TV reporter uncovers Mahabub's supernatural conspiracy that involves prominent names, Kamasani realizes that people have died or suffered because of his refusal to accept his own fate and vows to set things right.

programme.title: X-Game
programme.desc: Based loosely on a horror novel, four kidnapped university students become entangled in a revenge story born out of past bullying. Hideaki took part in a bullying game in his elementary school called 'X Game' where unsuspecting victims picked their fates from a lottery list of pranks. Imprisoned together with three other classmates from the elementary school, they are made to play a new type of ' X Game .' This time around, however, the bullying is much, much worse.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: Sara discovers her mom stabbing her dad with a knife before slicing her own throat. After a failed suicide attempt, the traumatized young woman awakes from a coma with total memory loss, only to be greeted by her husband, Nick, whom she has no recollection of. She tries to piece together the events that led to her attempted suicide and to get accustomed to her new life, but reality grows murkier everyday until she is unsure what is real and what is not.

programme.title: The Spirit of Ramayana
programme.desc: In order to prove herself to her family, 24-year-old contemporary dancer Mintra auditions for a new play called "Ramayana", hoping to land her dream role Seeda. But the director deems her too nice for the role, which portrays contrasting sides of good and evil. Instead, her rival Gina is chosen for the role, awakening resentment in Mintra and prompting her to accept the offer of a female ghost to help bring out her dark side.

programme.title: Kawan Aku Mati Dalam Rumah Sewa
programme.desc: Rudy is a film extra who is always playing ghost characters. Akhiruddin is a petrol station attendant. Remy shines shoes along the five-foot ways around the city. The three of them rent a house from Pak Cik Osman but they are three months behind in rent. One day, Pak Cik Osman's nephew Saipol, an illegal motor racer, comes to put with them for a while. That night, Saipol wins a race and goes home with RM10,000 in cash on him. Rudy so happens to get home at the same time, still in his vampire costume. Saipol is so frightened that he has a heart attack and dies on the spot. Akhiruddin and Remy follow behind and the three bachelors start panicking over what to do with Saipol's corpse. Will Saipol come back to haunt them and get back the money?

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam

programme.title: Black Hand
programme.desc: Jung-woo is a highly successful neurosurgeon who works in a bioengineering research facility. He is married but is having a clandestine affair with one of the female doctors there named Yoo-gyeong. One day Yoo-gyeong has a muysterious accident and her hand is severed. But due to his quick action, Jung-woo is able to save her life and reattach her hand using a newly developed technology. The revolutionary surgery even improves Yoo-gyeong's health and she feels better than ever. But there are terrible side-effects as bizarre events begin to happen around her.

programme.title: I Wish I Wish aka Deseo Deseo
programme.desc: Five cousins reunite at the house of their recent deceased grandmother. As they rummage through her belongings, they discover a curious board game titled 'I Wish, I Wish (Deseo, Deseo).' Out of boredom, they decide to play the game together. The rules are simple: each player may ask 3 wishes that will be fulfilled after completing a challenge presented by the game. If they carry it out they will have what they desire; otherwise there are far reaching consequences. The players soon learn the game truly grants their wishes -- at a heavy cost. For those who have chosen not to fulfill the challenge, the game releases a vicious creature to enforces punishment on their loved ones. The group soon discover that they must keep playing, and risking others is the only way to save themselves.
